subjectOf.text: The incidence of Dodd-Frank compliance cost falls on the management company rather than the fund: the responses indicate that the management company bears the brunt of registration and disclosure costs, and whether and how those expenses will be passed to investors over time is unclear.

It is unclear whether and how the increased expenses will be passed on to investors over time.
